symptom: One MCP server with "Also listens on" failed to start, and the whole chat refused to start, so the conversation and every other server were unavailable.
rule: A server that cannot start is left out of that chat: the chat starts without a notice and the server shows its error only in the composer's MCP tools list. Principles 5 and 13.
check: pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts apps/desktop/src/engine/agents/gateway/__tests__/launched-servers.test.ts apps/desktop/src/engine/agents/__tests__/gateway-mcp.test.ts apps/desktop/src/renderer/features/agent/__tests__/composer-tool-groups.test.ts -t 'does not start|cannot start|without a sign-in action'
